business_problem: KDAN wanted to add generative AI to its document management and eSignature products so it could automate analysis, extraction, and internal assistance while getting new offerings to market faster.
solution_summary: KDAN uses Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Llama 2, and Claude 3 to support AI-assisted document intelligence and workflow automation. KDAN wanted to add generative AI to its document management and eSignature products so it could automate analysis, extraction, and internal assistance while getting new offerings to market faster. In practice, the implementation runs transformation or AI logic on Amazon Bedrock. Documents, notes, and structured records are consolidated into a governed cloud data layer; Amazon Bedrock applies analytics or model logic. The case study reports KDAN Accelerates Development of Generative AI Applications by 50% with Amazon Bedrock, faster development of generative AI applications on AWS 50%, and increase in reporting efficiency 75%, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
